name: Itai Lior
headline: Full-Stack Product Engineer & Indie Maker
positioning: I architect scalable backends and ship polished web, mobile, and browser products.
availability: Open to remote contracts & MVP builds

experience.summary: Core features for Angor, an open-source decentralized crowdfunding platform built on Bitcoin and Nostr.
highlights: Build platform features in C# / .NET compiled to WebAssembly.
Work on staged fund releases that keep investors in transparent control of their capital.
Focus on secure, scalable flows in an open-source codebase developed in public.

experience.summary: Backend and DevOps work on eBay's Ontology platform — the category and metadata graph that structures every item, product and value on the marketplace.
highlights: Contributed to backend services in Java & Spring Boot, building REST integrations with RestTemplate.
Built Java infrastructure over a Neo4j graph database, using the Builder pattern to model and validate the catalog ontology.
Wrote Jenkins pipelines that automated release processes and streamlined CI/CD.
Ran regression flows on Jenkins and Kubernetes for safe, repeatable deployments.

experience.summary: Built and maintained internal web platforms for a national-scale organization — Node.js services, SQL data layers, React front-ends and test automation.
highlights: Developed internal full-stack web applications (Node.js, Express, React) used across multiple departments to streamline daily workflows.
Shipped a new web platform end-to-end for a large-scale candidate assessment program, from data model to UI.
Automated web processes with Selenium and wrote complex SQL to validate data integrity across interconnected systems.
Led a team of 5 in system testing & analysis and onboarded new engineers.

education.notes: Previously studied Computer Science at The Open University of Israel.

services.title: High-Scale Backend & APIs
services.description: Production-grade services, data models and integrations — designed the way they're built at eBay: observable, tested and ready for real traffic.

services.title: End-to-End Mobile & Web MVPs
services.description: From idea to app-store-ready product. One engineer owning frontend, backend and infra means fewer handoffs and a faster path to your first users.

services.title: Custom Browser Extensions & Automation
services.description: Chrome extensions, scrapers and workflow bots that bend existing websites to your team's needs — the same craft behind HeatReel.

creative.bio: When I'm not shipping code I'm making noise: piano, drums and guitar. Game jams are where the two worlds meet — a theme, a deadline, and a team of friends with no excuses.

venues.title: Two rooms that taught me to listen
venues.note: Late nights at North Gate Jazz Co-op in Chiang Mai and the Blue Note shaped how I build: listen first, leave space for the other players, and ship the take even when it isn't perfect.
